table_scope.note: the public test-patch table covers bug-fix PRs (type = fix) in repositories with both agent and human fix PRs only

scientific_energy_subset.rule: 17 named energy repositories, or a GitHub topic in the declared list, or a declared keyword in the repository name or description (t5a_repo_meta.json)

census_all_agent_prs_read.file: t5e_sci_census_labels.json (every mixed hunk of the 47 PRs read; t5e_sci_census.json)

detector_recall_stratified.structural_zero: hunks with only added or only removed lines cannot change an existing literal; 185640 such unflagged hunks are excluded from the base

detector_recall_independent_positives.note: undefined when the detector-independent sample holds no numeric edit

false_positive_items.note: bats @test block: server port in a shell command (setup), not an expected value
rapid.Check property test: input-range constant (maxAllocation), not an expected value
test rewritten to a different request (POST -> GET search); old status assertion replaced, not the same check
index on the actual side (must().get(0) -> get(1))
input argument inside an assertThrows lambda (retention days 0 -> 7)
batch-size limit inside the object under test (setup lambda); matched through a 'should...' method name
platform condition (sizeof(Int) == 8 -> 4) selecting the expected string, not an expected value

false_negative_items.note: FN: expected funnel dict 'count': 0 -> 1 more than 12 lines below the assertion opener (continuation window)
FN: numeric tolerance removed (BeApproximately(x, precision: HighPrecision) -> Be(x)); symbolic tolerance, not a literal

defects_fixed_in_v2: keyword 'should' matched inside test-name strings and comments
identical lines mis-paired after reformatting or reordering
development_round.note: v1 labels were used only to find defect classes; reported estimates come from the fresh v2 sample, which excludes every v1 hunk

stage2_note: the public table cannot power a Stage-1 registered report on scientific/energy repositories; a Stage 2 would have to mine fresh agent PRs from scientific and energy-modelling repositories (GitHub API or a later AIDev release), which needs a working GitHub token and the author's recorded legal basis

hand_check.annotator: the builder (an AI model), single rater, rule stated in this file's docstring
